command:
set -u
ERR=/var/jb/var/mobile/WindowServer.err
START=$(wc -l < "$ERR" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
echo "WS_PID_BEFORE=$(ps aux | awk '/Resources\/WindowServer/ && !/awk/ {print $2}' | head -1)"
echo "=== probe run ==="
/var/jb/usr/macOS/bin/launchdchrootexec 0 0 /var/mnt/rootfs /usr/local/bin/macos_ws_event_probe post
echo "PROBE_RC=$?"
sleep 2
echo "=== WS log delta ==="
tail -n +$((START+1)) "$ERR" | grep -E "CGXSYNTH|LOADER-OBS" | head -40
echo "=== delta line count ==="
tail -n +$((START+1)) "$ERR" | grep -cE "CGXSYNTH|LOADER-OBS" || true
